messages:
carla: Quick pass — I pushed the updated annual goals doc here: https://go.redwood/annual-goals-draft. Need final alignment + sign-off from execs by EOD tomorrow. Highlights: tightened O1 success metric, split O2 into delivery vs reliability, added cost guardrail suggestion for infra.

anya: skimmed. big picture looks good. can we call out which items are must-have for Q2 vs stretch? that's the blocker for eng prioritization.

devon: +1 on must-have vs stretch. also need explicit launch criteria for Dedicated (latency P95, throughput target, and regression tolerance). otherwise we can't promise Q2 launch.

carla: noted — added a short Launch Criteria section under O2. example lines are: `Latency P95 <= 120ms`, `Sustained throughput >= 200 rps per pool`, `Rollback triggers: error rate delta > 1.5x baseline`.

ravi: for O1 metric (activation -> embeddings adoption), we should standardize on a 30d activation window. Proposed KPI formula:```activation_rate = activated_users_30d / new_accounts_30d```and I'll add the SQL snippet to the doc.

devon: asking for clarity on the rollout plan. if we agree to Dedicated GA in Q2 we need canary capacity and fallback to hosted model variants. That impacts staffing for infra in the first 6 weeks.

anya: to resolve, propose we tag features with `must-have`/`nice-to-have` and set a cutoff: only `must-have` work for the Q2 committed slate. I linked a priority matrix in the doc under "Decisions".

michael: high level: I'm comfortable signing the goals once we get two things: 1) a simple cost guardrail (max avg token cost per 1k requests) and 2) a canary+rollback plan that avoids product downtime for top 5 customers.

carla: Michael — added cost guardrail proposal: `max_avg_cost_per_1k = $X` (placeholder until finance provides final). Also created a TODO for the canary plan owner.

devon: can we surface the customer-driven asks? support flagged 3 enterprise customers asking for private deployment timelines. if those are must-haves we need to shift Dedicated delivery earlier.

ravi: support ticket links pasted in the doc comments. two are contractual asks, one is exploratory. I flagged them with customer impact scores.

anya: decision call: carve out contractual customer work as "customer commitments" outside the public Q2 slate; Dedicated GA remains our public promise if we hit must-have items. customers with contracts will get a private schedule that may pull from the same engineering runway.

michael: fine with that approach. formally: I sign off on the objectives contingent on Carla sharing the canary runbook + cost number in tomorrow morning's all-hands readout.

carla: will do. I'll update the doc with the canary runbook skeleton tonight and ping SRE for the runbook owner.

support-bot: Reminder set: notify @carla and @michael 8:00 AM tomorrow about goal signoff. :white_check_mark:

anya: thanks everyone. if no objections by EOD tomorrow we treat this as approved and start mapping PRDs to the committed slate.

devon: I'll prepare the engineering breakdown (2-week slices) once must-have list is final.

carla: tl;dr — small edits in doc, must-have vs stretch added, cost guardrail placeholder, canary plan TODO. signoff goal: EOD tomorrow. Appreciate quick eyes. :rocket:
